note: Behavior contract for repair, in the shape and review evals' format. Each eval runs the repair skill in a fresh session on a fixture repo the prompt describes, with Jev off and no target project rule calling for a proof clause; a grader scores each expectation true or false against the committed specs and mockups, the repair commit message, and the product code. They prove repair-specs #acceptance-criteria-proof-kept (1), #acceptance-criteria-two-screens and #acceptance-criteria-split with each proof clause kept on the split it proves (2, 3), #acceptance-criteria-artifact-then (4), #acceptance-clean-harness (5), #acceptance-criteria-given-gesture (6), #acceptance-rule-source (7), #acceptance-rule-source-unedited (8), #acceptance-rule-source-validator (9), #acceptance-mockup-shipped (10), with tests/runtime-prototype.mjs framing that route for #acceptance-mockup-shipped-review, #acceptance-mockup-missing (11), #acceptance-mockup-drawn (12), #acceptance-mockup-kept (13), #acceptance-no-jev (14), and repair's half of prompt-first-shaping #acceptance-proof-clause-rule (1 to 4) and mockups #acceptance-fidelity-rule (10 to 13). tests/repair-specs.sh proves #acceptance-rule-source-text.

evals.prompt: Run repair on a repo whose criterion reads "proven by a unit test: no screen shows it" and whose Given names the fixture user tf-admin, and whose specs say tf-admin is an internal admin acting in a client account.
expectations: The committed Given names an internal admin acting in a client account, never tf-admin
The committed criterion still reads "proven by a unit test: no screen shows it", word for word
The repair commit message lists tf-admin as that role's fixture user for the target's qa.toml
No criterion gains or loses a test level, proof method, or proving test

evals.prompt: Run repair on a repo whose criterion's Then needs both the inbox and the board and reads "proven by an e2e test on the board", and whose specs say how the user reaches each screen.
expectations: The committed spec shows one criterion per screen; the first keeps the original anchor, the new one has a new stable anchor and a When reaching its screen
The board criterion reads "proven by an e2e test on the board", word for word
The inbox criterion carries no proof clause, since that clause proves only the board outcome

evals.prompt: Run repair on a repo whose criterion's Given joins a creator on the free plan or on the team plan with or, whose only outcome is an analytics event no screen shows, and which reads "proven by a unit test: no screen shows it".
expectations: The committed spec shows one criterion per plan; the first keeps the original anchor, the new one has a new stable anchor
Each of those criteria reads "proven by a unit test: no screen shows it", word for word, since the clause proves each one's outcome
Each Then states in product terms that the event is recorded

evals.prompt: Run repair on a repo whose criterion's Then reads that posthog-captures.jsonl holds one funnel event, an event no screen shows.
expectations: The committed Then states in product terms that the funnel step is recorded once
The spec no longer shows posthog-captures.jsonl
The repair commit message lists posthog-captures.jsonl for the target's qa.toml
The criterion gains no test level, proof method, or proving test

evals.prompt: Run repair on a repo whose product spec has a section describing a provider stub and the capture file it writes.
expectations: The committed spec shows neither the stub nor the capture file
Every behavior clause of the spec remains
The repair commit message lists the removed harness setup for the target's QA docs

evals.prompt: Run repair on a repo whose criterion's Given reads that the creator has the sidebar collapsed.
expectations: The committed Given holds only state a fixture can set and the creator's device and appearance context
The committed When opens with the creator collapsing the sidebar

evals.prompt: Run repair on a repo whose criterion's Then reads only that the error banner no longer shows, and whose specs say the saved draft then shows in the drafts list. The repair skill's text names no rule about a Then that states only an absence; the shaping contract's criterion rules gained that rule after the repair skill last changed.
expectations: The committed Then also names something visible that proves the end state, the saved draft showing in the drafts list
The criterion keeps its anchor
The repair skill's files are unchanged

evals.prompt: Run repair on a repo whose criterion's When says the learner looks at the graph, whose specs say the learner reaches the graph by opening it, and whose Git history shows no commit has edited that criterion since the shaping contract's When-action rule was added.
expectations: The committed When names the learner opening the graph, and no looking or reading step
The committed Then names what the graph shows
The criterion keeps its anchor

evals.prompt: Run repair on a repo whose spec's drawn mockup, of a host product's page whose chrome the project does not own, named in its mockup-chrome meta and drawn from a copy of that host's published design tokens, paints its primary button a color no token declares, and that no commit has edited since it was committed.
expectations: The committed mockup takes that color from a token its frames declare by the design source's name and value
validate-style.py --whole-spec passes on the spec against the commit the run started from
The mockup keeps its file and every anchor
No product code has changed

evals.prompt: Run repair on a repo whose product runs and ships the weekly report screen its spec states, at a route its code serves, and whose mockup set draws that screen as a wireframe whose regions illustrate two spec anchors.
expectations: The committed mockup of the weekly report names the shipped screen's route and draws no frame
Its regions and steps illustrate each spec anchor the wireframe illustrated
The mockup keeps its file
No product code has changed

evals.prompt: Run repair on a repo whose product runs and ships a settings screen its spec states, at a route its code serves, with no mockup of that screen in the spec's mockup set.
expectations: The committed mockup set holds a mockup of the settings screen naming its shipped route
No product code has changed

evals.prompt: Run repair on a repo with a DESIGN.md design source whose spec states an export dialog the project owns and its product does not serve yet, drawn as a wireframe in its mockup set.
expectations: The export dialog's mockup file is unchanged, byte for byte
No product code has changed, and no prototype is written
validate-style.py --whole-spec passes on the spec with a warning naming that mockup

evals.prompt: Run repair on a repo whose drawn mockup of chrome the project does not own already meets every mockup rule of the shaping contract.
expectations: That mockup's file is unchanged, byte for byte
No repair commit message names that mockup

evals.prompt: Run repair with Jev off on a repo whose spec has an audit section, a clause the repo's board spec owns, a clause naming the export formats that disagrees with the export spec, a criterion naming the first card where the specs say it shows the lane with a QA bundle, a page-level style block, and a wireframe mockup of a screen the product ships, and whose ADR holds a rules section.
expectations: The committed spec shows no audit section
The clause the board spec owns reads in the committed board spec and no longer in the spec that held it
The committed spec and export spec no longer disagree on the export formats: the out-of-date side is updated, or an open TBD names the choice

Each rule of that ADR reads in its home spec as an acceptance criterion, a new ADR holds the current decision and names that ADR as superseded, and that ADR keeps every word, gaining only its superseded line
The committed criterion names the lane with a QA bundle, and no screen position or order
The committed spec has no page-level style block and links the repo's shared spec stylesheet
The committed mockup names the shipped screen's route
The run makes no project-rule proposal
